# Still Afloat

> Still Afloat is a cruise travel-advisory and content brand run by Mark — a retired IT manager, U.S. veteran, and former liveaboard sailor with 20+ years of cruising experience. The mission: help everyday cruisers make smarter decisions. "Cruise smarter. Laugh more. Stay Afloat." Content is the honest take of an experienced friend, not influencer hype or cruise-line marketing.

## About

- [Work with Mark](https://stillafloatcruising.com/work-with-mark.html): Travel-advisory services and the contact form for booking a cruise or asking a question. Mark is a travel advisor hosted by the Cornerstone Collective agency.
- [Subscribe](https://stillafloatcruising.com/subscribe.html): Free weekly newsletter — curated cruise news, port weather, and travel intelligence.

## Content

- [Cruise News](https://stillafloatcruising.com/news.html): Curated, AI-assisted, human-approved cruise industry news for travelers.
- [Commentary](https://stillafloatcruising.com/commentary.html): Mark's honest take on cruise decisions, reviews, and planning.
- [Cruise Port & Destination Weather](https://stillafloatcruising.com/weather.html): Live conditions at major U.S. embarkation ports and Caribbean/Bahamas destinations.
- [Live Cruise Cams](https://stillafloatcruising.com/webcams.html): Live webcams from popular cruise ports and beach destinations.
- [Mark's Favorites](https://stillafloatcruising.com/favorites.html): YouTube channels and cruise websites worth following.

## Gear (affiliate)

- [Cruising Gear](https://stillafloatcruising.com/affiliate.html): Cruise and travel gear recommendations, curated by category. Product links are affiliate links (Amazon Associates and cruise partners).

## Spanish (es-419)

- [Versión en Español](https://stillafloatcruising.com/es/): Full Spanish-language site for Latin American cruisers.
